# AutoRig.online

> > AutoRig.online is an automated character rigging service that converts T-pose OBJ, FBX, and GLB models into animation-ready characters for Unity and Unreal Engine.

The platform serves as a Mixamo alternative, offering 50+ animations and supporting modern workflows including Humanoid avatars, Skeletal Mesh import, and animation retargeting. It provides both web-based tools and API access for game developers and 3D artists working with Unity Mecanim and Unreal Engine pipelines.

## Key Topics

- Auto-rigging
- Character rigging
- T-pose preparation
- FBX format
- GLB/glTF format
- OBJ format
- Unity Humanoid avatars
- Unreal Engine Skeletal Mesh
- Animation retargeting
- Mixamo alternative
- Unity Mecanim
- A-pose vs T-pose
- Mesh preparation
- PBR textures
- 3D character animation

## Core Services

- [Auto Rig OBJ Online — Convert OBJ to Rigged GLB/FBX](https://autorig.online/obj-auto-rig): Main OBJ rigging service: upload T-pose models, export to GLB/FBX formats
- [Mixamo Alternative: Auto Rigging + Animations for GLB/FBX/OBJ](https://autorig.online/mixamo-alternative): Mixamo alternative with 50+ animations for GLB/FBX/OBJ, Unity/Unreal ready
- [Buy Credits](https://autorig.online/buy-credits): Purchase credits for AutoRig service and API access
